verdict.rationale: The GitHub README says LLM-driven extraction 'supports all LLMs (open-source and proprietary)', and the docs list LLM-based structured extraction and 'no forced API keys'. Together these indicate the extraction backend is not tied to a cloud model. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of configuring a local or self-hosted endpoint (e.g., a base URL or Ollama-style provider setup), and any hands-on or independent confirmation that local models work for extraction.
